editRecipe: Downmix stereo to mono, resample 44.1 kHz to 22.05 kHz (polyphase 1:2), trim leading silence at a -50 dBFS gate keeping 5 ms of pre-roll, cut at the per-use cap, 2 ms linear fade-in, cosine fade-out over the last fadeOutMs, peak-normalize to -3.1 dBFS (the opening Polaris ping's peak), 16-bit PCM.
